d: We are seeking a qualified and compassionate Staff Nurse to join our healthcare team. They will be responsible for providing high-quality nursing care, monitoring patients' health conditions, assisting physicians during medical procedures, and ensuring patient safety and comfort while maintaining compliance with healthcare standards and clinical protocols.
q: li
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Nursing from an accredited institution.
li
Valid Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) classification and registration.
li
Valid professional license to practice in Saudi Arabia.
li
Minimum 1–2 years of clinical nursing experience is preferred.
li
Experience in outpatient clinics or medical centres is an advantage.
li
Good knowledge of nursing procedures, patient assessment, and infection control standards.
li
Strong communication, interpersonal, and patient-care skills.
li
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
r: li
Provide direct nursing care to patients in accordance with established clinical standards and protocols.
li
Assess patients' health conditions, monitor vital signs, and document clinical observations.
li
Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians.
li
Assist physicians during medical examinations, procedures, and clinical interventions.
li
Prepare examination rooms and ensure medical equipment and supplies are available and properly maintained.
li
Monitor patients' conditions and promptly report any changes or medical concerns to the treating physician.
li
Educate patients on medication instructions, treatment plans, and general health practices.
li
Maintain accurate and updated patient medical records and nursing documentation.
li
Ensure proper infection prevention and control practices, including sterilization and medical waste disposal.
li
Support patient admission, discharge, and follow-up procedures when required.
li
Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure compliance with healthcare regulations and facility policies.
li
Collaborate effectively with physicians and other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated patient care.

We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Executive to join our vibrant team.
Under the general guidance and supervision of the Director of Sales implements all sales activities and maximizes business opportunities in his / her specific area of responsibility.
Strong knowledge of event planning, banquet operations, conference management, and guest service standards.

q: li
